last_scene.summary: RETCON replaces the earlier unresolved reconstruction of 'Принцесса'. Arlequino performed his exact user-supplied adapted lyrics. The audience had expected a romantic song about a girl, a princess and letters. The opening cemetery image immediately broke that expectation; 'Напишу в могилу ей / Напишу письмо' drew dark laughter and uneasy reactions. The sequence 'Три, девять, сорок дней' and the attempted summoning made the magical listeners pay closer attention. 'Не прошёл эксперимент' reframed the song as a failed necromantic experiment rather than romance. The strongest shocked/comic reaction came when the returned princess was described through 'Грязно-зеленый гной / Трупного процесса'. The final punchline 'В мире мертвых до сих пор / Нету почты' produced the largest laugh because it completed the earlier letter setup. Reactions remained mixed: some civilians found the corpse imagery disgusting, younger fighters and several magicians laughed at the black humor, and the healer woman visibly disliked the decomposition imagery. Tips +23s64c; expenses 0; net +23s64c. Personal cash became 22g67s84c.
